files.title: PDF URLs
files.description: Direct links to digital PDFs (reports, papers, manuals, contracts, invoices). Scanned PDFs need the OCR Actor first.

includeMarkdown.title: Put the Markdown in the dataset
includeMarkdown.description: Each row gets a markdown field, handy for LLM / RAG pipelines and integrations. A .md file is always saved too.

pageBreaks.title: Mark page breaks
pageBreaks.description: Adds a --- line between pages (useful for citing page numbers in RAG).

maxPages.title: Max pages per PDF
maxPages.description: Only the first pages are converted; each page is charged.

maxFileSizeMb.title: Max file size (MB)
maxFileSizeMb.description: Larger files are skipped with an error (not charged).
